AC-1.given_when_then: Given the retired review path, when source/imports and tests are inspected, review/** and REVIEW-SCRIPT are absent, the relocated RETIRED guard is live, and its recorded mutation fails.
AC-1.detail: 31 review files gone; 58 total deletions match the story. Old mutation: 1 failed + 1 passed + 17 skipped; restore: 2 passed + 17 skipped. Current runGate: 21/21 including both guard tests.

AC-2.given_when_then: Given current frontend code, when deleted symbols/imports are searched, CodeTab, inference, authoring feature, legacy IR, Redux testSteps and the flag/barrels have no surviving code consumers. The authoring transport retains its studioApi caller.

AC-3.given_when_then: Given the single public OpenAPI, when the contract harness checks operations, all surviving public operations have a handler or a valid PO-ruled entry; stale or newly uncovered operations fail closed.
AC-3.detail: 43 operations, 35 public; 19 handled plus A10/B1/C5. validateTestVariables is handled. Readiness enum and LEARN_REQUIRED are contract-checked; v3 artifacts validate. 69/69 contract cases pass. Negative-control evidence confirms missing-handler and stale-A/C failures, without counting filtered skips.

AC-4.given_when_then: Given READY, activation re-reads after saving and sends one replay. Given any non-READY state, Run is disabled with the exact interim sentence. Given 409 LEARN_REQUIRED, it renders once without retry or retired narrative.
AC-4.detail: runGate AC-4 (a)-(g) and page-level cases pass. Dirty edits hide the learned chip; the always-mounted polite region announces a stop after save. Live-run polling retains 2s/1.5x/15s backoff without compile bounds.

AC-5.given_when_then: Given rendered copy and the source tree, when vocabulary and UX strings are checked, production compil hits are zero, the mandatory never-learned sentence and learned chip are exact, and reserved relearn-from-step copy is absent.
AC-5.detail: 15 test-only exceptions are enumerated (three new UX-fix comment/assertion lines account for the increase from the draft gate’s 12). COPY-001..004 match UX’s replacements.

AC-6.given_when_then: Given baseline and final evidence, when test names are reconciled and final gates are checked, 854 - 216 + 57 + 4 = 699 story tests; two preserved unrelated hook tests make 701 total, and final-source type-check, lint, production build and full vitest succeed.
AC-6.detail: Initial removed/added name sets exactly equal the ledger; five baseline unloadable suites are explicitly not counted. QA independently ran production build and 126 targeted tests without skips. S4c ran all 56 FE files including all 7 WCAG cases. The final S4c log has per-file counts rather than per-case JSON; every file/count matches the UX name set plus the two hook names.
